hero.eyebrow: Web design and development studio · Santiago, Chile
hero.subtitle: We design and build landing pages, websites and brands for businesses that want more leads. Clear prices, defined timelines and support after launch.

lines.h2: Four lines, one goal: getting you contacted.
lines.description: Choose where to start depending on where your business is. Each line has three tiers with a defined price and timeline.

steps.title: Describe what you need.
steps.description: Tell us about your business and your goals. We review your situation and propose the tier that suits you best, with a clear price and timeline.

steps.title: We design your solution.
steps.description: We create the structure, the copy and the visual design. Every decision aims at the same thing: that whoever lands on your site gets in touch.

steps.title: We build and deliver.
steps.description: We build your mobile-friendly site, test it and publish it within the agreed timeline. You review and we adjust before going live.

steps.title: We grow with you.
steps.description: After launch you can stay with a monthly plan: hosting, changes, reports and new features whenever you need them.

plans.h2: Your site is not launched and forgotten.
plans.description: After launch you can stay with us: hosting, changes, reports and new features depending on what you need.

contact_short.h2: Shall we talk about your project?
contact_short.text: Tell us what you need and we will reply within 24 business hours with a clear proposal.

services_page.h1: Every service, with price and timeline.
services_page.intro: Prices in Chilean pesos (CLP). Pick a category to compare tiers or review packs, plans and add-ons.

start.text: Before investing in a new site or brand, we review what you already have and tell you what to do first.

intros.landing: A single page that presents your business and turns visits into leads. All three include domain and first-year hosting.
intros.rediseno: Your current site, refreshed to look good and generate leads.
intros.reposicionamiento: Brand identity and message to stand out from your competition.
intros.crecimiento: Full websites, stores and custom platforms. This is the Growth line, not the monthly Growth Plan.
intros.packs: Service bundles at a discount. Savings are calculated on each component's list price.
intros.planes: Monthly support after launch. The Growth Plan is a monthly plan, different from the Growth line.
intros.complementos: Add whatever you need to any landing page, website or redesign.

services_page.footnote: Prices in Chilean pesos (CLP). Prices marked "from" are confirmed in the quote depending on the scope of each project.
